brief:
Hamas urged Palestinians, Arab and Muslim nations, and international supporters to make Friday a day of solidarity and anger in defense of Palestinian causes, the Shehab Wire reported Thursday. The Islamic Resistance Movement called on the public to demonstrate commitment to all Palestinian issues through the planned mobilization.

The movement specifically emphasized Jerusalem and Gaza as priority concerns in the Friday demonstrations. Hamas framed the call as an appeal for unity across regional and global audiences in response to conditions affecting Palestinians.
